newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 24.954 bln stg week to Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 24.954 bln stg week to Jan 15.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 24.954 billion stg in the week to January 15 from 24.686 billion the week earlier, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 was 24.566 billion stg compared with 25.025 billion a week earlier.
Notes and coins in circulation rose to a seasonally adjusted 24.771 billion stg from 24.628 billion the previous week while on an unadjusted basis they fell to 24.383 billion from 24.967 billion.
